newsitem.title: USA: Patriot's Cal Jockey merger is on track.
newsitem.headline: Patriot's Cal Jockey merger is on track.

text.p: Patroit American Hospitality Inc on Monday said its agreement to acquire Cal Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co was on track to be completed by June 30.

The company said revised proxy materials reflecting its agreement to acquire Wyndham Hotel Corp and 11 hotels from Trammell Crow family partnerships would be filed soon with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Patroit, the second-largest U.S. real estate investment trust, said it expected "the acquisitions announced today to be accretive to Patroit's funds from operations per share upon completion and to contribute significantly to per-share growth in 1998 and future years."
It said the acquisitions were expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997.

"We are absolutely committed to completing the Cal Jockey/Bay Meadows merger," Patriot said. "We have remained in close contact with management and the boards of Cal Jockey and Bay Meadows and are working closely with them in preparing definitive proxy materials."
Upon completion of the Cal Jockey/Bay Meadows and Wyndham transactions, the company said, it intends to remain the paired operating company "Wyndham International."
It said the paired shares of Patriot American Hospitality and Wyndham International would trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol PAH.
